|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1-2022-10-04-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1-2019-02-11.gif]], 11 February 2019) → [[File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1-2022-10-04-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V1-L-greenleaderingreensquadron1.gif]], 4 October 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E1”, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
